html:
Halal Tours in Vietnam and Things to Know? Are you a Muslim and love to travel? Are you planning to travel Vietnam? Do you want to know about Halal tours in Vietnam? and how long it will take for you to visit and explore all the beauty of Vietnam.

Vietnam is a country with many attractive tourist destinations suitable for Muslims. Halal tourism in Vietnam is currently developing strongly with Mustim tours, halal cuisine and hotels. This is one of the tourist destinations that are friendly to Muslims. The following shares will help you learn more about it!

How is Halal Tourism Developing in Vietnam?

Vietnamese culture is a blend of many beliefs, including Buddhism, Catholicism, Protestantism, Islam and other religions, and the culture, cuisine, customs, and traditional costumes are very unique and diverse.

According to statistics from the Vietnamese government, Muslims account for a low percentage of the Vietnamese population, only about 1-2%. The number of Muslims is not as large as that of major religions, but is still very diverse.

The Muslim community in Vietnam is often concentrated in the South and Central regions. Although the number is not large, the culture and life of the Muslim community in Vietnam is still an essential part of the culture. Halal tourist destinations in Vietnam are also a way for Muslim tourists to learn and experience the unique culture of the Muslim community in Vietnam.

Halal in Vietnam is becoming increasingly important from culture to economy. Many restaurants in major cities in Vietnam now offer Halal food and religious services. In addition, many hotels have also catered to the needs of Muslim tourists by providing separate areas for men and women, religious services and Halal-standard amenities.

Some destinations in Vietnam that are suitable for Muslim tourists include Hanoi, Da Nang, Vinh and Ho Chi Minh City. Other popular tourist destinations are Nha Trang, Hoi An, Da Lat and Phu Quoc. These locations have a wide range of Halal food options and other services suitable for Muslim tourists when traveling to Vietnam.

In addition, Halal destinations also offer cultural and religious activities for Muslim tourists to learn and experience the unique features of Vietnam.

Top Halal Tours in Vietnam

The Halal industry in Vietnam is growing and expanding to all major cities and popular tourist destinations, Halal standard tours Vietnam are available for Muslim travelers.

Hanoi Muslim Tourism

Hanoi is the capital of Vietnam and the center of culture, economic history. and when coming to Hanoi, visitors can also choose options such as Halal restaurants in Hanoi, especially Indian and Middle Eastern restaurants. Halal restaurants serve dishes made from chicken, beef, goat, seafood and fresh fruits and vegetables.

Finding Halal food in Hanoi is easy, because there are many Halal restaurants and eateries in Hanoi.

In particular, visitors can visit Al-Noor Mosque. This is one of the important Islamic religious sites in Hanoi and the only mosque in Northern Vietnam, the mosque has the typical architecture of a mosque.

Visitors can visit, admire and participate in spiritual activities but must comply with the dress code and religious rituals of the mosque.

In addition, Muslim tourists can also visit religious services in Hanoi, including temples, pagodas and other religious sites. Some destinations not to be missed when coming to Hanoi are: Ngoc Son Temple, One Pillar Pagoda, Huong Pagoda, Hanoi Cathedral…

Muslim Tours Saigon

Saigon is one of the largest and culturally diverse cities in Vietnam, with many activities and places to visit for Muslim tourists. Coming to Saigon, you can visit the following sacred places of Islam:

Minh Mosque (Masjid Jamia Al Muslimin): One of the largest mosques in Saigon, built in 1935. Where the Muslim community comes to pray and hold ceremonies. You can admire the unique architecture, learn about the culture and history of the Vietnamese Muslim community.

Al-Rahim Islamic Cultural Center is a famous Islamic cultural center in Saigon, established in 2013. Here, you can take courses on Islam, enjoy Halal cuisine and participate in local Muslim community games.

Cat Lai Mosque Saigon was built in 2008, where the Muslim community comes to pray and perform rituals.

In addition, when traveling to Saigon, tourists also visit other places in Saigon such as Binh Tay Islamic School and Halal food court around Bui Vien street…

Mekong River Muslim Tour

The Mekong River is the largest river in Southeast Asia, flowing through many countries such as China, Myanmar, Laos, Thailand and Vietnam. In Vietnam, the Mekong River has many attractive tourist destinations for Muslim tourists. Here you can find many diverse Halal tourism activities such as:

Visiting traditional craft villages or watching artisans make products such as: Conical hats, pottery, gardening tools, … or visiting ancient towns of many ethnic groups. Join waterfall tours, explore the rainforest and visit unique architectural and religious works, visit the floating market and experience the typical cuisine of the Mekong River region, such as fish cakes, dry hotpot, sugarcane juice, …

Ha Long Bay Muslim Tour

Ha Long Bay is one of the famous destinations, with poetic natural landscapes, recognized by UNESCO as a world natural heritage. In addition, there are many destinations for Muslim tourists.

Although Ha Long Bay does not have many religious tourist attractions like other Muslim tourist destinations, there are still many interesting activities and experiences that Muslim tourists can participate in such as:

Visiting caves in the Ha Long Bay area, such as Tien Ong Cave, Dau Go Cave, Luon Cave, Sung Sot Cave, Thien Cung Cave… visiting islands such as Ti Top Island, Ngoc Vung Island, Quan Lan Island…

Visitors can freely admire the sea and island space, and experience the life of the fishing village people, or participate in water sports, such as surfing, diving, kayaking, … exploring the beauty of the ocean.

Enjoy delicious and attractive cuisine with fresh seafood such as: Lobster, crab, clam… so, Ha Long Bay is an ideal destination for Muslim tourists who want to explore the natural beauty and culture of Northern Vietnam.

Muslim tour Vinh Lan Ha

Vietnam Halal tour must take advantage of the destination Vinh Lan Ha – one of the most beautiful beach destinations in the summer. Lan Ha Bay with its pristine beauty and poetic beaches, Lan Ha Bay is becoming an attractive destination attracting tourists from all over the world to visit, enjoy and participate in interesting activities on the sea.

In the summer, from April to June, the sea is calm, the weather is sunny and windy, the sky is clear and blue, very beautiful for tourists to visit and enjoy the scenery on the bay, especially by speedboat to see the scenery, traveling to Cat Ba in September in the low season, the sea is calm, tourists can freely visit and explore the beauty on the beach such as surfing, rowing, hiking …

Therefore, Lan Ha Bay is increasingly developing many tourism projects, so Muslim tourists can rest assured about the Halal standards here. You can find restaurants serving delicious Halal food and many Halal hotels that meet the standards and can accommodate you whenever you visit the bay.

3. Top Halal Restaurants in Vietnam

Muslims from all over the world visiting Vietnam can experience halal cuisine that meets the standards. Halal delicacies are served at various restaurants across the country. Here are some halal restaurants you should try when visiting Vietnam on a halal tour.

The restaurants are divided by region, making it easier for you to choose.

Hanoi

  • During your Muslim tours in Vietnam, you can visit Hanoi and enjoy halal food at many different restaurants such as:

Namaste Hanoi

  • This is a famous halal Indian restaurant in Hanoi, with Indian dishes prepared in halal style.

Address: 46 Tho Nhuom Street, Hoan Kiem District, Hanoi

Opening hours: 11:00am – 2:00pm & 6:00pm – 10:00pm

Zaynab Restaurant

  • With a luxurious and professional space, Zaynab Restaurant always offers a diverse menu of rich halal dishes to meet the needs of customers. In addition, the restaurant also provides home delivery service for customers in the Hanoi area.

Address: 12 Hang Luoc Street, Hang Ma, Hoan Kiem, Hanoi

Opening hours: 11:00 am – 4:00 pm

Naan n Kabab Restaurant

  • This restaurant serves halal dishes from chicken, beef, lamb, fish, shrimp, squid, snails and vegetables. The restaurant has halal Indian cuisine.

Address: 49 Xuan Dieu, Quang An, Tay Ho, Hanoi

Opening hours: 11:00 am – 3:00 pm, 5:00 pm – 11:00 pm

In addition, many other halal restaurants in Hanoi such as Batavia Restaurant, D’Lions Restaurant, Juni’s Kitchen also serve cuisine for Muslims and tourists.

Saigon

  • In Saigon (HCMC), many Halal restaurants also serve Indian, Middle Eastern and Asian cuisine. There are many 5-star Halal restaurants with diverse menus, bringing Muslim diners the most comfort and satisfaction.

Kampung Melayu

  • Kampung Melayu is a Halal restaurant specializing in Malaysian and Singaporean cuisine. Highly appreciated for its rich flavor and good quality. In particular, the restaurant’s famous dishes bring to diners such as: Chicken Rice, Malaysian Milk Tea and Nasi Goreng Telur…
  • In addition, Kampung Melayu also has a spacious, comfortable space, suitable for visitors traveling with family and friends.

Address: No. 1, Nguyen An Ninh, Ben Thanh Ward, District 1

Opening hours: 17:30 – 23:00

Babas Kitchen

  • This is a Halal Indian restaurant in Hanoi, specializing in bringing diners a variety of delicious Indian dishes.

Address: 274 Bui Vien Pham Ngu Lao, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City

Opening hours: 11:00 am – 10:30 pm

Daun

  • Daun is a Halal restaurant specializing in European, Vietnamese and Singaporean cuisine, highly appreciated by many tourists for its quality and unique flavors. At Daun, you can enjoy many delicious dishes such as nasi lemak, satay, roti canai, curry, fruit juice and other attractive desserts…

The restaurant has a spacious space, beautifully decorated and luxurious, bringing visitors the best culinary experiences when coming to Vietnam.

  • Address: 48 Le Lai Street, Ben Thanh Ward, District 1
  • Opening hours: 12 pm – 9 pm

Some other halal restaurants in Saigon:

  • Kebaby
  • Natraj Indian Restaurant
  • Shanti Indian Cuisine
  • Mumtaz Indian Restaurant
  • Beirut – Mediterranean Kitchen & Lounge
  • Al Sham Restaurant

Da Nang

Besides the natural beauty, Halal cuisine in Da Nang is also one of the highlights. Especially for Muslim tourists traveling to Da Nang, there will be a list for tourists to choose from as follows:

Nan N Kabab Halal Restaurant

This restaurant is one of the famous halal cuisine spots in Da Nang, Vietnam. This restaurant is beautifully and luxuriously designed, with a spacious and airy space. Nan N Kabab Halal serves halal food, especially Indian dishes such as kebabs, toasts, grilled dishes, chicken rice, … Famous desserts such as: Halwa and gulab jamun. The dishes here are all made from fresh and traditional ingredients.

  • Opening hours: 10:00 am – 10:00 pm (every day of the week) & 10:00 am – 10:30 pm (Friday, Saturday, Sunday)
  • Address: 233 Ho Nghinh, Son Tra, Da Nang
  • Cuisine: Indian, Asian, Middle Eastern, and Pakistani

Mumtaz Indian Restaurant

Mumtaz is the first halal Indian restaurant in Da Nang, opened in June 2008. The restaurant serves halal, South Indian, Gujarathi and vegetarian Thalis for North Indians. The restaurant is beautifully decorated in traditional Indian style, with hand-painted murals and lanterns that look very eye-catching.

You should try Mugali Mutton Briyani, Chicken vindaloo and Mutton Rogan Josh when you come here.

  • Opening hours: 10:30 am – 10:30 pm
  • Address: 69 Hoai Thanh Street, My An, Ngu Hanh Son, Da Nang
  • Cuisine: Vegetarian Indian

Namaste Omar’s Restaurant

Namaste Omar’s is a popular restaurant with six locations that has been open for over 20 years. Come here to enjoy the best food and fresh meals with special cooking styles. You can also experience traditional Vietnamese halal cuisine with the most Halal tour in Vietnam.

  • Opening hours: 10:30 am – 10:30 pm
  • Address: 6 Thai Phien, Hai Chau District, Da Nang
  • Cuisine: Indian food

Halal Food at the Airport

  • You may feel hungry before or after your flight. A great halal restaurant will help you satisfy your hunger effectively. Check out the popular halal restaurants at international airports in Vietnam below:

Noi Bai Airport

Confetti Restaurant and Café

  • Location: Terminal 2, Noi Bai International Airport.
  • Food style: Halal food, vegetarian food, Vietnamese cuisine

Hai Cang Restaurant

  • Location: Terminal 2, Noi Bai International Airport.
  • Food style: Hong Kong and Chinese food

Ngoc Suong Restaurant

  • Location: Terminal 2, Noi Bai International Airport
  • Food style: snacks and sweet desserts

Tan Son Nhat Airport

Tan Son Nhat Confetti Restaurant

  • Location: 1st and 3rd floor, International Terminal
  • Food style: Halal food, Asian – European food

Spice India Tan Binh Restaurant

  • Location: 42 Hau Giang Street, Ward 4, Tan Binh District, Ho Chi Minh City
  • Food style: Indian food

An Tan Vegetarian Restaurant

  • Location: 50 Nguyen Minh Hoang Street, Ward 12, Tan Binh District, Ho Chi Minh City
  • Food style: vegetarian food
